fusions.name: Tether's Length
fusions.desc: Runs the full circle of your tether, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Snapping Slack
fusions.desc: Whips a length of chain at the first enemy in its path, dealing 7 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Haul to the Stake
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Link Holds
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
